Note generation time might dominate my 180 s tool limit. Let me generate 64 instances once and cache them to a file, then time the planner separately.

Actually bigfeas takes ~1-2 s per instance to generate (path enumeration). 64 × 1.5 s = 96 s. Let me generate 24 and replicate/vary them to make 64 lines. import json, sys, random, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
